headline: Saudi Arabia's Tadawul All Share Index Closes 2.65% Lower
summary: Saudi Arabian equities dropped sharply at market close, with the benchmark Tadawul All Share Index declining 2.65%.
why: The Tadawul is the largest equity index in the Middle East and reflects investor sentiment across the region's energy and financial sectors.

impacts.name: Tadawul All Share Index
impacts.why: Broad selling lowered the benchmark equity index across trading sectors.

why_moved: Widespread selling across domestic equities pushed the benchmark Tadawul All Share Index down by 2.65%.
